scope: Read-only postimplementation mechanical audit by the original implementer; separate coordinate/tensor checks, not a second independent design reviewer

mapping_checks.method: Independent inverse coordinate checks, without invoking exporter mapping: Q/K HF halves equal native even/odd coordinates per head for both weights and biases; V unpermuted; O/MLP/head transposed; norms flattened; all source and target keys consumed exactly

numerical_limit.explanation: The historical verifier compared full HF/mtstudio logit matrices inside a temporary directory, then retained IDs and maximum error in hashed receipts. The matrices were deleted. This audit validates their recorded result/provenance, not an offline recomputation of that numeric error. No fresh forward was run.

remaining: Tied heads and modified flex variants remain refused; fixture evidence is tiny CPU interoperability only, not model quality, GPU behavior, chat rendering or all possible configurations.
artifact_path_handling: Frozen metadata contains Windows-relative artifact names; auditor normalized directory separators only when reading from WSL.
